preamble: Palatalization of the lateral liquid can lead to a voiceless postalveolar fricative, often via intermediate stages of palatalized laterals and affricates.

examples.note: Observed in specific historical stages of palatalization
Common Turkic merged Proto-Turkic *ĺ into š; Oghur keeps l (Chuvash utmăl).

sources: Ladefoged, P., & Maddieson, I. (1996). The Sounds of the World's Languages.
